question: How should the free Hetzner experimental Inference API in compute/hetzner-inference-api be reconciled with inference/hetzner-inference-api, which already covers the same offer at the inferred rung?
why: This discover unit's scope is a new compute record from the models.dev seed; an existing inference record with the same offer and URL is outside the unit's scope, so no change or relation was proposed here. An integrator or a later verify unit can decide whether to relate or consolidate the two.
